identity.source_note: Publisher MIGRATED Elsevier->Wiley: the official journal site arthroscopysportsmedicineandrehabilitation.org now 301-redirects to the Wiley journal page, and the old ScienceDirect guide 404s. The CURRENT Wiley Guide-for-Authors is Cloudflare-blocked (403 'Just a moment') to WebFetch, headless Apify render, AND curl; the Wiley forauthors URL is inferred from sister journals (Arthroscopy, Arthroscopy Techniques /hub/journal/<code>/homepage/forauthors.html) and is itself unverified (blocked). Values were encoded from the journal's OWN official ASMR manuscript templates ('Version 1 - July 2018', Elsevier Health Advance CDN) read via Wayback archive snapshot http://web.archive.org/web/20240310103643id_/https://els-jbs-prod-cdn.jbs.elsevierhealth.com/pb/assets/raw/Health%20Advance/journals/asmr/ASMR_Original_Article_Template.pdf and http://web.archive.org/web/20220419181801id_/https://els-jbs-prod-cdn.jbs.elsevierhealth.com/pb/assets/raw/Health%20Advance/journals/asmr/ASMR_Systematic_Review_and_Meta-analysis_Template.pdf . These snapshots are >12 months old and pre-migration, but the template digest is byte-identical across 2022->2024 captures (stable) and the family's numbers (4000w/7figs/15parts) appear verbatim in Google's crawl of the current Wiley parent-journal (Arthroscopy) guide, corroborating carry-over. REQUIRES Janine live-Wiley-guide verification before launch.

encoding_notes: PUBLISHER MIGRATION: Elsevier -> Wiley. Official site arthroscopysportsmedicineandrehabilitation.org 301-redirects to arthroscopyjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/2666061X; ScienceDirect guide 404s. Current Wiley Guide-for-Authors is Cloudflare-blocked (403) to WebFetch, Apify headless render, and curl.

SOURCE: encoded from the journal's OWN official ASMR Original Article + Systematic Review/Meta-analysis templates ('Version 1 - July 2018', Elsevier Health Advance CDN), read via Wayback archive (2024-03 / 2022-04 snapshots). Snapshots are >12mo and pre-Wiley-migration, but template digest is byte-identical 2022->2024 (stable) and the family numbers (4000w/7figs/15parts) match Google's crawl of the CURRENT Wiley parent-journal (Arthroscopy) guide. NOT verified against the live ASMR Wiley guide.
guidelines_url (Wiley forauthors) is inferred from sister journals and was blocked (403) -- treat as unverified.

article_types limited to original_research + systematic_review because only these two official templates were reachable. ASMAR (broad-scope companion to Arthroscopy) very likely also accepts case reports, technical notes, letters, editorials, etc., but no evidence was found -- OMITTED rather than guessed.

BLINDING: double_blind/scrub flags inferred from the 'blind title page' file that both templates exclude from the word count (classic anonymized-review setup: full title page + separate blinded title page). Confirm against the live Wiley peer-review policy.

WORD CAPS (explicit in templates): Original Article manuscript 4,000 words; Systematic Review/Meta-analysis 4,500 words; both exclude 'title page, blind title page, references, figure legends'. Abstract 300 words for both types.
FIGURE CAP: figures_max=7 but templates also allow '15 total figure parts' -- the sub-part allowance cannot be represented in the schema (SCHEMA GAP). Table cap 4 for both types.

REFERENCES: order=cited and journal_abbrev=nlm are explicit ('numbered consecutively in the order in which they appear in the text'; 'Follow PubMed journal abbreviations'; 'most within the past five years'). The style NAME and the in-text marker (superscript vs bracket) are NOT specified in the templates -> style/in_text left null. (Arthroscopy family is AMA-superscript by convention, but that is not stated in-source.)

STRUCTURED ABSTRACT sections for both types: Purpose, Methods, Results, Conclusions, Level of Evidence, Clinical Relevance. Level of Evidence is a required abstract element; Limitations is required as the final paragraph of Discussion.

NOT STATED in templates -> left null/false: page size, font family/size, line spacing, margins, alignment, first-line indent, line numbers (set 'none' as conservative default; double-blind journals often require continuous line numbers -- VERIFY), page numbers, running head, running-title/title length caps, author degrees, keywords (required=false is a conservative default; live guide likely requires keywords -- VERIFY), figure DPI/formats/naming, table placement/caption position/numbering, declarations block order, ORCID, cover letter, highlights, title case.
[schema-required default] references.in_text defaulted to 'bracket' (guide did not state the in-text citation marker; schema requires a value; inferred from reference style 'None').
[schema-required default] references.style defaulted to 'vancouver' (guide silent; schema requires a value).
[schema-required default] figures.legends_location defaulted to 'in_text' (guide silent; legends left where authored).
